citations.raw: Vin. Ab. Trial, (B. 2), 10, cites 29 Ap. xxxvii. 19, (E. 2)
citations.note: year book cited through Vin. Ab. Trial (B. 2) 10, on trial by inspection of nonage. This edition prints '29 Ap. xxxvii. 19 (E. 2)', as the 1835 text and those following it do; the 1824, 1827 and 1831 editions, Tyler's 1871 and 1882 and Andrews's 1901 print '29 Ass. 37', the Liber Assisarum, 29 Edw. III, pl. 37, and 'Ap. xxxvii.' is read as a misprint of that (xxxvii being 37): cited by plea, so no page, plea 37 here. '19 (E. 2)' is Viner's further reference with no folio, not recorded. No source for the year books. Medium, the cite being read from the other editions' text; interim reading pending the owners' decision (consistency pass)
